text:
sana: morning team, joining from BLR timezone. Okta login succeeded but device trust is blocking me from enrolling passkeys - "device not compliant". My Mac is company-issued but MDM shows serial mismatch. Also need access to eng-oncall mailbox and VPN for internal services. 1Password invite says "org at capacity" when I try to accept. Can someone advise? :wave:

it-support: welcome @sana! tagging @idp and @kyra. short-term we can give VPN and mailbox access via a temp link and add you to a new-hires 48h 1Password seat. what's your laptop serial (DM if sensitive)?

sana: DM'd serial. VPN client is Perimeter81; installer fails with "authentication required" after SSO. Eng-oncall mailbox is eng-oncall@redwood.ai - I need delegated access asap for handover.

jamf-bot: Jamf sync report: device serial XZ-9876 not found in MDM inventory. Possible causes: device imaged under old asset tag or serial recorded incorrectly.

idp: @sana thanks for serial. looks like inventory mismatch. two options: 1) IT can re-register device in Jamf (will require screenshare and 10-15 mins), 2) we can provision a temporary certificate to satisfy device-trust for 24h while Jamf is reconciled. Which do you prefer?

sana: temporary cert would be ideal, got a couple hours before first handover. VPN + mailbox are higher priority.

kyra: 1Password: allocation spike today. giving you a temporary 48h seat now and resending invite. Also creating a temp vault "new-hires-temp-48h" with eng-oncall keys and VPN prep notes. Check spam if you don't see the invite.

okta-bot: Device trust exception created for user sana@redwood.ai (24h). Passkey enrollment will be allowed for the session. Please complete MFA and enroll backup factor.

it-support: provisioning temp mailbox delegation to eng-oncall (view/send as) for 24h. VPN token created and DM'ed installer link - try the installer again after accepting the 1Password temp seat for credentials. We'll keep ticket open.

security: quick note: since we're using a temporary cert and mailbox delegation, please enable a backup MFA method (phone or 1Password TOTP) and do not store sensitive keys unencrypted. We'll audit the temp vault and remove after 48h.

sana: thanks team, temp seat received and VPN installer worked after I entered the temp cred. mailbox access ok. starting Jamf re-register now with IT screenshare. will confirm when done.

it-support: screenshare scheduled in 10. leaving exception window open 24h. reopen if anything else breaks. :thumbsup:

sana: re-register complete, Jamf now shows correct serial. okta-bot: device trust re-evaluated and now compliant. passkey enrolled via Touch ID. marking resolved; thanks all! :white_check_mark:
